lines.text: Many learners say: Please prevent me when you arrive.
Better: Please tell me when you arrive.
The second one! Please tell me when you arrive.

native.tip: « Prévenir quelqu’un » se dit “tell” en anglais. “Prevent” veut dire « empêcher ».

en.tip: French « prévenir » means to tell someone ahead of time: say “tell”. “Prevent” means to stop something.
en.caption: Do you say this? “Please prevent me when you arrive.” French « prévenir » means to tell someone ahead of time: say “tell”. “Prevent” means to stop something. Say “Please tell me when you arrive.” Listen to Ama and repeat with her! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
